# Skoda Construction Inc.

> Family builders of custom homes on Florida's Gulf coast, from Boca Grande to Marco Island: new homes, remodels, storm restoration and commercial build-outs. The family has built since 1950; Chris Skoda founded Skoda Construction Inc. in 1985. All jobs are owner supervised by Chris Skoda (founder and president) and his son Mike Skoda (vice president). Florida license CBC1266776, Certified Building Contractor, held by Michael Skoda for Skoda Construction, Inc.; licensed since July 16, 2023, current and active through August 31, 2028 (Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation). Offices in Naples, Florida, and in the Cleveland, Ohio area. Phone 239-777-7288; email skodabuilding@gmail.com.

## Services

- [New custom homes](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#homes): new homes in communities and on individual home sites, with your architect and designer or theirs. Before anything is drawn, they check the lot: will the home fit, are the utilities and the soil ready, what does the community require, do you need help with the design.
- [Remodels](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#remodels): whole-house remodels, kitchens, bathrooms, additions, open floor plans and outdoor living, with your architect and designer or theirs.
- [Storm restoration](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#restoration): homes damaged by hurricanes, wind or water, rebuilt to the standard they had before the storm. They match what survived (stucco, paint, wallpaper, trim, banisters, staircases, patio stones) and have pieces made when they can't be found. Restoration around the clock. The page follows one house, damaged in November 2022 and rebuilt by December 2023.
- [Commercial](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#commercial): project management, offices, tenant improvements, restaurants, retail, medical and dental offices, hotels and spas. Every commercial job is owner supervised; work is planned around business hours, overnight when that keeps a business open.

## Budgets

The ranges on their consultation form:

- New homes: $1 million to $5 million, $5 million to $10 million, $10 million or more.
- Remodels: $250,000 to $500,000, $500,000 to $1 million, $1 million or more.

## Family

- [1950](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#family): Joe Cicero, Chris Skoda's grandfather, starts building houses.
- [1985](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#family): Chris Skoda founds Skoda Construction, after years of remodeling properties. He has a background in civil engineering and real estate and oversees project management and field operations on every job.
- [2014](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#family): his son Mike Skoda joins the company, with a degree in marketing and management from Ohio University.
- [2023](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#family): Mike Skoda becomes a Florida certified building contractor.

## Reviews

Seven reviews on their website.

- [Salvatore T., a new home](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#homes): "He completed the home on time, and his tradesmen were reliable and trustworthy."
- [John M., wind damage repairs](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#restoration): "He was very knowledgeable on how to work with the insurance company to get the repairs completed … The repairs were completed and covered."
- [Lou A., insurance repair projects](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#restoration): "…prepared a detailed estimate that was readily accepted by the insurance company, and performed the work on time."
- [Robyn L., retail build-outs](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#commercial): "Chris is a top quality contractor with very reasonable pricing and always delivers on time."

## Service area

Office in Naples. Eleven towns in three counties:

- [Collier County](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#area): Naples and Marco Island.
- [Lee County](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#area): Boca Grande, Captiva, Sanibel, Fort Myers, Fort Myers Beach, Estero and Bonita Springs.
- [Charlotte County](https://www.skodaconstructionflorida.com/#area): Port Charlotte and Punta Gorda.

A second office serves clients in the Cleveland, Ohio area.
